title: Compose normal exit bypasses the Desktop-owned terminal finalizer and cleanup wait
reachability: Production Main invokes bare Compose application. Pinned1.11.1 published source defaults exitProcessOnExit=true and calls exitProcess(0) after awaitApplication returns. Normal window/tray close reaches real Compose exit; process exit does not execute Main outer finally/finishDesktopRuntime2500ms wait.
counterguards: requestClose already starts cleanup jobs; some may finish first. Compose disposes composition and the real clipboard service has its own ownership-aware JVM shutdown hook. Not a claim that all cleanup is absent, observed data loss, late onboarding work or authentication bypass.
grouping: Distinct from PVA010 native context/cancellation lifetime and original PVU006 terminal late work; original PVU006 remains unresolved. Original25/suspicion12 denominators unchanged; all confirmed38→39 only.
planned_fix: Explicit exitProcessOnExit=false through a small production loop seam; retain existing Main finally, coordinator timeout/once-only logic, clipboard hook and outer System.exit.
planned_regression: One case with serial fresh JVM historical-default control and real production Compose loop; actual normal exit must return through finally and reach explicit outer continuation. No interception/mock of Compose/System.exit. Source-only, independently reviewed before execution.
limits: Published-source/JAR-coordinate association is not executed bytecode equivalence. Real child-process regression and independent patch review remain pending; no full app/Koin/Room/provider/device/no-flash claim.
